decisions.notes: CWE-126 present links strlen(dest) to memcpy but omits the selected short dataBadBuffer and its capacity, which establish the out-of-bounds read relation.
CWE-134 present links a local pointer assignment to fwprintf but omits the fgetws-controlled format-buffer flow needed to justify the uncontrolled format-string assessment.
CWE-190 present links the constant initialization data = 0 to data * data and omits the fscanf input and missing arithmetic bound.
CWE-191 present links data = 0 to data - 1 and omits the recv/atoi input path and missing lower-bound guard.
CWE-194 present links an unrelated socket listen condition to the int cast and omits the short conversion and later signed length use that form the scoped relation.
CWE-195 present links the post-copy dest[data] write to memmove and omits the negative/untrusted data value converted to the copy length.
